title.en: Attentive doctors and friendly clinic team

text.en: Pet owners consistently commend the clinical team for their professionalism, warmth, and clear communication. Reviewers frequently single out Dr. Roberto Bernal and Dr. Martinez for explaining medical findings in simple terms and guiding owners with patience. Clients also appreciate the courteous front-desk reception and caring nursing assistants.

title.en: Empathetic handling for cats and dogs

text.en: Reviewers emphasize the tender, respectful care shown toward pets during examinations and surgical procedures. Owners of small dogs such as Chihuahuas and Yorkies report that visits are kept gentle and reassuring, minimizing stress for both pets and their families. Several clients praise the staff for treating animals like beloved family members.

Multiple clients highlight the clinic's affordable fee structure, describing charges for exams, medications, and surgical procedures as honest and fair. Pet owners appreciate transparent treatment recommendations without unnecessary upselling, allowing families to keep their companions healthy without facing excessive financial burden.

q.en: Does Isa Animal Clinic offer convenient evening appointment hours?

a.en: Yes, pet owners appreciate that the clinic stays open late on weekdays, making visits convenient after regular working hours.

q.en: How do clients rate the affordability of treatments here?

a.en: Reviewers consistently describe procedure costs and routine checkup fees as fair, transparent, and budget-friendly.

q.en: Do veterinarians take time to explain diagnoses and treatments?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently praise Dr. Bernal and the team for explaining conditions thoroughly in clear, easy-to-understand language.
